habitats.name: Sunny Jungle
habitats.intro: The jungle animals are hiding! Strike each pose to make a new friend appear.

habitats.name: Deep Blue Ocean
habitats.intro: Dive under the waves! Every pose helps a sea creature swim home.

habitats.name: Cozy Farm
habitats.intro: The farm is waking up! Do each pose to say good morning to an animal.

habitats.name: Whispering Forest
habitats.intro: Tiptoe through the forest and meet its shy, wonderful creatures.

habitats.name: Big Bright Sky
habitats.intro: Spread your wings! Each pose sends a flying friend soaring into the sky.
